references.text: God says that he will meet Moses above the mercy seat between the cherubim, which explains why the mercy seat is a holy place where God reveals himself.
The description of the curtain that separates the Holy Place from the Most Holy, where the mercy seat and the ark of the covenant are located.
Aaron shall make atonement on the altar once a year, which shows the limited access to the Most Holy.
The cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle, which explains why God says he will appear in the cloud above the mercy seat.
Nadab and Abihu died when they came before the Lord with strange fire, which is the direct background for the warnings in this verse.
Moses heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat over the ark of the covenant, between the two cherubim.
Only the high priest enters the second room, and only once a year, and not without blood that he offers for himself and for the sins committed by the people in ignorance.
Christ entered into heaven itself to appear before God on our behalf, unlike the high priest who could enter only once a year.
Through Jesus' blood we have boldness to enter the sanctuary through the curtain, which is his body—a fulfillment of what was limited under the old covenant.
